additional_info.subject: Creation Request: Verification of 300 kW Charger Capacity - MP/R6 17000200
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am reaching out as we have observed an unusual issue with the Sicharge D charger (serial number: MP/R6 17000200), and we would like to ensure that its 300 kW capacity is unaffected. We suspect that one of the electric trucks may have a potential power demand issue.
1) First truck – The charger appears to have delivered the expected 300 kW power:
- Date: 10/29/2024
- Start time: 11:48:45
- End time: 12:27:08
- Charging duration: 00:38:22
- Energy consumption: 133.94 kWh
2) Second truck – The charger did not seem to reach full capacity, or there may have been a limitation on the power demand:
- Date: 10/29/2024
- Start time: 12:33:42
- End time: 13:35:36
- Charging duration: 01:01:54
- Energy consumption: 160.47 kWh
Please verify these details and confirm that the charger is operating at full capacity.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485

additional_info.subject: ID0387110-DC/Si-D/FR[170002001] - Charging Capacity CRM:00315001978
additional_info.body:
Dear Malek, long time no see. I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R6 170002001
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
4HIbKg
Problem Description
: Charging capacity
Troubleshooting
:
From our logs, we can clearly see that the charger has a maximum power available of 280kW:
As you can see the EVSE_MaxPwr[kW] = 280kW and the provided power is 211kW, which is measured from the NowCur[A]xNowVol[V]. So in sum, the EV is requesting 330A and 662V = 218KW and is being provided 328A and 643V = 211kW.
The reason why the charger cannot go to Max=300kW is because there is a communication error from one converter and that is the reason why only 20kW are missing. I can arrange a regional colleague to resolve this issue since it's a simple problem.
Even though the converter is missing, the EV is still requesting less, than what I assume you expect, as you can see he is requesting 330A, if he is to require 300kW it should request 453A, considering that the 662V are always constant.
Let me know yours thoughts and questions.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0387110
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
